## Historical audit — H0054

**Source for all citations:** `/srv/lab-disks/disk2/users/xymo/hint-codex-experiments/runs/codex_parallel_05/lanes/codex_parallel_05_lane3/codex_parallel_05_lane3_shared/hint_gen/kea-atomic-signal-selectors/trajs.json`. Event offsets below refer to the supplied decoded observations.

| Aspect | Evidence and interpretation |
|---|---|
| Inferred task goal | The guide describes an opt-in Kea selector engine for leaf-level invalidation, selector health and targeted notifications. This is the teacher’s characterization, not an independently observed task specification. [main_agent:event:23, chars 0–9435] |
| Teacher role and input | This is a **teacher-only, read-only-guidance trace**. The teacher read `/tmp/golden_diff.diff`, an 821-line reference patch proposing a proxy, dependency graph, scheduler and integrations; reading a proposed patch is not applying it. [events 1–2, chars 0–584 and 0–71391; event 23, chars 0–9435] |
| Autonomous exploration | The teacher searched repository integration points and read selector, reducer, context, mount, React hook, middleware, wrapper and type files. The selector source shows placeholders followed by Reselect wrappers; middleware calls `next(action)` before action listeners. [events 3–4, chars 0–966 and 0–6570; event 6, chars 0–8509; event 16, chars 0–7160] |
| Diagnosis versus proposals | The guide flags the reference patch’s wrapper evaluation counter and graph/notification timing for scrutiny. It proposes stable identities, refreshed dynamic dependencies, cycle checks and targeted tests. These are recommendations and hypotheses, not executed fixes or demonstrated failures. [event 21, chars 0–9380; event 2, chars 0–71391] |
| Actual changes and validation | A write created `/tmp/hint_output.md`; the tool confirmed creation. The teacher reported that the repository remained unchanged and no branch or commit was created. The earlier `git status --short` produced no status entries, but there was no final independent status check or test execution in the visible trace. The empty `structuredPatch` belongs to the new guide-file write, not an evaluated student patch. [events 3–4, chars 0–966 and 0–6570; events 21–23, chars 0–9380, 0–9283 and 0–9435] |
| Receipt and outcome | The guide’s creation and final presentation are visible; **student receipt or adoption is not**. Metadata records the teacher session as completed successfully, but that is not formal success, partial correctness, or algorithm failure for an implementation. Implementation outcome is **unknown**, with no visible evaluation or technical interruption. [top_level_metadata, chars 0–13372; event 23, chars 0–9435] |

**Lessons and uncertainty.** Transferably, separate a reference patch and design diagnosis from tested behavior; inspect lifecycle and notification ordering before assuming a cache is safe. Task-specific concerns include Kea’s two-pass selector identity, collection-read tracking and React subscription fallback. Whether the proposed approach handles conditional dependencies, cycles, reentrant dispatch or collection edge cases remains untested here. This is a code task, not a scene trace; object, material, pose, camera and rendering checks are not applicable.
